summary: Qapilo iteration 6 (rebrand + 50u/150l curriculum + endless Practice + AI-Tutor live context + Watchlist widget). Backend: 15/15 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_6_qapilo.py PASS. AUTH: signup/login/accept-terms all healthy; new users get is_pro=true via 7-day trial; wrong-password rejected. CURRICULUM: GET /api/curriculum?lang=en returns 50 units, 150 lessons, each unit has tier 1-5 and 3 lessons; units u21..u50 have pro=true and u1..u20 have pro=false (regardless of trial state); DE and ES localized titles differ from EN on ALL 50 units. Trial user has pro_locked=false everywhere (as expected). LESSON: GET /api/lessons/l1 returns 3 cards + 4 questions in en/de/es with identical option counts; POST /api/lessons/l1/complete awards XP (perfect run gives base_xp scaled, first_time=true, l1 added to completed_lessons). PRACTICE: GET /api/practice returns 5 questions each with q/options(exactly 4)/answer(int)/tier(1-5) + reward_xp + tier + max_tier + practice_level; DE localization keeps 4 options; POST /api/practice/complete awards XP, bumps daily_xp and streak. TUTOR: POST /api/tutor/chat with 'What is the current price of Apple (AAPL) today?' returns a reply containing digits (live price from Finnhub) AND 'not financial advice / educational only' disclaimer as required. General non-realtime question ('what is a stock?') also succeeds. Frontend (390x844, fresh signup uit6_<hex>@qapilo.app + agreement): AUTH typing regression FIXED — name/email/password TextInputs all accepted typing (input_value read back matched typed strings). Agreement gate rendered and 'Agree & Continue' progressed to Learn tab. Learn tab shows: Daily-goal bar, 'Endless Practice' CTA (testID practice-cta), and units with 'LEVEL N · Beginner/Foundation/Intermediate/…' tier labels + winding node path (Money Made Simple / What Is Investing? etc.). Tapping practice-cta opened the practice quiz which rendered 4 practice-option-i buttons; answering advanced through questions (verified Q3-of-5 progress bar). Profile tab loaded (T6 Tester header, 'Pro Trial Active — 7 days of free Pro left', Level 1, 0 XP, 0/150 lessons, and Watchlist widget with empty state prompting to star stocks). Language switcher visible in Learn header. All tested testIDs resolved.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Appears twice during signup + agreement. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx

(Carried over from it_5) Disambiguate testIDs on Explore vs Stock-detail star buttons — main agent's job (unchanged this iteration).
(Optional refactor) server.py is now ~1148 lines; consider splitting routers (auth, curriculum, practice, tutor, watchlist, paypal) for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: TouchableWithoutFeedback wrapper has been removed from /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx — only Pressable and TextInput remain, which is why typing now works. Regression fix VERIFIED via Playwright input_value reads.

GET /api/curriculum unconditionally sets pro=true for u21..u50 via `u['id'] in PRO_UNITS`, independent of the user's is_pro flag — spec compliant. `pro_locked` is per-lesson and correctly false for trial users.
curriculum.py gracefully skips missing units — currently ALL 50 are present in curriculum_data.json (validated: 50 units, 150 lessons, DE+ES translations for each).

AI Tutor real-time context (server.py:804 gather_realtime_context) triggers on price/quote/today/now/etc. keywords OR symbol detection; live Finnhub quote is injected into the prompt and Claude naturally includes the number in its reply. Disclaimer is enforced via TUTOR_SYSTEM prompt — verified appearing in reply text.
Tavily is dormant (TAVILY_API_KEY empty) — tavily_news() returns [] silently; tutor still works via Finnhub price context alone. Matches expected behavior per user note.
Practice endpoint uses stable question de-duplication (used-set on q text) and enforces exactly 5 questions with exactly 4 options each (verified in backend tests).
